paper.title_en: Carrollian Dictionary for Massive Particles at Null Infinity
paper.abstract_en: Massive particles reach timelike rather than null infinity, leaving their Carrollian boundary description unresolved. We construct a Carrollian dictionary for massive one-particle states on $\mathscr I^\pm$ without requiring their worldlines to reach null infinity. The dictionary encodes the bulk momentum through its projections onto the null frame associated with each celestial point. The Poincaré intertwining equations require the complete Carrollian representation to describe massive states. We apply the dictionary to the Källén--Lehmann representation and to soft photon and graviton theorems. The Källén--Lehmann application fixes the coefficient function of the non-contact two-point function in terms of the bulk spectral density. Soft theorems show that global modes reproduce the ordinary $U(1)$ and Poincaré actions, whereas local actions remain integrals over celestial directions.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文构建了无质量粒子在类空无穷远处的卡罗尔字典，涉及广义相对论基础，具有理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 类空无穷远处大质量粒子的卡罗尔字典
decision.abstract_zh: 大质量粒子到达类时而非类空无穷远，留下其卡罗尔边界描述未解决。我们在$\mathscr I^\pm$上为大质量单粒子态构建了一个卡罗尔字典，而不要求它们的世界线到达类空无穷远。该字典通过每个天球点相关的零标架上的投影来编码体动量。庞加莱交织方程要求完整的卡罗尔表示来描述大质量态。我们将该字典应用于Källén--Lehmann表示以及软光子和软引力子定理。Källén--Lehmann应用根据体谱密度固定非接触两点函数的系数函数。软定理表明，全局模式重现了普通的$U(1)$和庞加莱作用，而局部作用仍然是天球方向上的积分。
